physicsmod.menu.general.title.main.info: Define how many physics objects can be active at once or th' maximum number o' threads used. Also includes some particle settins'.
physicsmod.menu.general.title: General Settins'
physicsmod.menu.general.cputhreads.info: After changing this ye will need t' reload th' world t' apply changes.
physicsmod.menu.general.playbackspeed.in: Speed o' physics simulation. Allows fer slow motion. High values be very CPU intensive 'n low values be th' opposite. Low values also mean delayed player interaction wit' physics objects.
physicsmod.menu.general.pvpservercompati: Enables Physics fer entities that simply disappear without triggering th' death event. When enabled bees going into hives, mob transformations 'n spawning mobs in peaceful mode will trigger physics.
physicsmod.menu.general.itembreakphysics: Turns a broken item into small physics object (only in first person view). Only works fer up t' 32x32 resource packs.
physicsmod.menu.general.crackphysicspart: Enables Physics fer particles while cracking a block.
physicsmod.menu.general.sprintingphysics: Enables Physics fer particles while sprinting on a block.
physicsmod.menu.general.eatingphysicspar: Enables Physics fer particles while eating.
physicsmod.menu.general.serverblockPhysi: Enables Physics fer particles when receiving fall damage 'n other block particles received by th' server packets.
physicsmod.menu.gravity.customize.reset: Be ye sure ye wish t' reset yer gravities?
physicsmod.menu.gravity.customize.title: Gravity Rules (join a world t' see dimensions)
physicsmod.menu.mobs.title.main.info: Change th' behaviour o' mobs when they die. Turn them into ragdolls, their individual parts or let them crumble into pieces!
physicsmod.menu.mobs.title: Mob Settins'
physicsmod.menu.mob.ragdollbreak.info: This needs either th' type <Ragdoll Breaking> or <Ragdoll Blood> t' be enabled
physicsmod.menu.mob.ragdolllimit.info: Limits th' amount o' ragdolls being active in th' world. This settin' can be useful fer giant mob farms.
physicsmod.menu.mobs.customize.title: Mob Rules
physicsmod.menu.mobs.customize.reset: Be ye sure ye wish t' reset yer mob settins'?
physicsmod.menu.mobs.edit.title: Scribble Mob %s
physicsmod.menu.blocks.title.main.info: Adjust th' way blocks crumble when they be getting destroyed. Small particles, th' entire block or fractured pieces. Whatever yer heart desires!
physicsmod.menu.blocks.title: Block Settins'
Describes at which distance t' th' player (in blocks) it should stop activating block physics.
physicsmod.menu.blocks.customize.reset: Be ye sure ye wish t' reset yer block settins'?
physicsmod.menu.blocks.customize.title: Block Rules
physicsmod.menu.blocks.edit.title: Scribble Block %s
physicsmod.menu.ocean.title.main.info: Experience th' thrill o' navigating th' vast, open oceans o' Minecraft wit' realistic ocean physics that allow ye t' feel th' power o' th' waves 'n th' wind on yer sails!
physicsmod.menu.ocean.title: Ocean Settins'
physicsmod.menu.ocean.title.warning: Ocean Settins' §c(Increase wave distance t' shore t' avoid visual glitches!)
physicsmod.menu.ocean.rainpuddles.info: Creates puddles when rain particles hit th' water.
physicsmod.menu.ocean.rainpuddles.deacti: Requires Weather Particles & Water Ripples t' be activated.
physicsmod.menu.ocean.ripples.info: Requires Ocean Physics t' be on! Creates ripples on th' water surface around entities.
physicsmod.menu.ocean.hitbox.info: Adjusts th' hitbox o' blocks t' be correct, this might result in a kick or ban on servers so use it wit' caution!
physicsmod.menu.ocean.blockrange.info: This decides how far away from th' shore th' water has t' be t' form big waves. Also takes into account th' deepness o' th' water body.
physicsmod.menu.ocean.reset: Be ye sure ye wish t' reset yer ocean settins'?
physicsmod.menu.dynamicblocks.title.main: Advance yer gameplay by turning vines, doors, trapdoors 'n hanging signs into physics objects.
physicsmod.menu.dynamicblocks.title: Dynamic Block Settins' (PRO VERSION REQUIRED)
physicsmod.menu.dynamicblocks.maxloadedb: Only activates th' nearest X amount o' block physics
Be ye sure ye wish t' reset yer dynamic block settins'?
physicsmod.menu.dynamicblocks.add.title: Stow Dynamic Block
physicsmod.menu.dynamicblocks.edit.title: Scribble Dynamic Block
physicsmod.menu.cloth.title.main.info: Elevate yer gaming experience by giving yer player a bespoke cloth simulated outfit, or turn mundane capes, banners 'n leashes into an eye-catching physics simulation. Take it up a notch by designing yer very own physics-based player customizations 'n watch yer creation come t' life in th' game!
physicsmod.menu.cloth.title: Cloth Settins' (PRO VERSION REQUIRED)
physicsmod.menu.cloth.forcearmor.info: Forces armor t' show even though some cloth pieces hide them. Useful fer PvP when ye need t' know which armor yer opponent is wearing.
physicsmod.menu.cloth.entityclothrange.i: At this distance threshold (in blocks) it will switch t' static rendering 'n stop simulating th' cloth.
physicsmod.menu.cloth.bannerdistance.inf: Th' distance at which th' banner physics switch back t' default minecraft banners.
physicsmod.menu.cloth.changesinfo: Player customization changes can take up t' 30 seconds t' be visible!
physicsmod.menu.cloth.proinfo: Only player cloth customizations o' Pro users be visible! Player customization, cape/banner/leash/fishing line physics be only in th' Pro version!
physicsmod.menu.cloth.downloading.title: Downloading Cloth...
physicsmod.menu.items.title.main.info: Get ready fer some action! Snowballs, Enderpearls 'n Eggs can now shatter into pieces when hitting an object!
physicsmod.menu.items.title: Projectile Settins' (PRO VERSION REQUIRED)
physicsmod.menu.liquid.title.main.info: BETA! Test liquid physics in Minecraft 'n see how it could look in th' not so distant future!
physicsmod.menu.liquid.title: Liquid Settins' (PRO VERSION REQUIRED)
physicsmod.menu.liquid.cudaliquids.info: High quality liquids simulated on yer GPU. High performance impact. Might cause game crashes. Commands fer spawning liquids be below when enabled.
physicsmod.menu.liquid.cudaliquids.error: Only Nvidia GPUs on Windows be supported!
physicsmod.menu.liquid.size.info: Changes th' particle size o' th' liquid.
physicsmod.menu.liquid.cudaliquids.messa: GPU physics be now enabled 'n might have issues wit' other parts o' th' mod (or decreased performance overall). This feature is in BETA 'n only intended fer cinematics/testing right now.
physicsmod.menu.liquid.waterdensity.info: This controls th' density o' infinite water sources.
physicsmod.menu.liquid.liquidthreads.inf: More threads can improve th' FPS o' liquids but might decrease yer Minecraft FPS.
physicsmod.menu.liquid.warning: This is a beta release o' th' liquids so that ye can play around 'n test them. T' spawn a continuous liquid source break an enchanting table (ye can stop th' source by placing a block on th' source, everything is only CLIENT SIDE). Blocks that create a vanishing liquid source: melon, wet sponge, pumpkin, cactus, filled water cauldron.
physicsmod.menu.liquid.reset: Be ye sure ye wish t' reset yer liquid settins'?
physicsmod.menu.snow.title.main.info: Minecraft never looked more ready fer th' winter. Plow through th' snow, enjoy th' atmosphere 'n even leave trails in it!
physicsmod.menu.snow.title: Snow Settins' (PRO VERSION REQUIRED)
physicsmod.menu.snow.reset: Be ye sure ye wish t' reset yer snow settins'?
physicsmod.menu.snow.snowthickness.info: Thickness fer snow. Only works wit' round + smooth shaded snow.
physicsmod.menu.snow.levelofdetail.info: Determines th' level o' detail fer snow that is far from th' viewer.
physicsmod.menu.snow.snowtrackentities.i: Th' selected amount o' entities closest t' th' player leave tracks in th' snow. Too high values result in delayed tracks.
physicsmod.menu.snow.snowtrackdistance.i: Th' maximum distance from th' player where entities leave tracks in th' snow. Too high values result in delayed tracks.
physicsmod.menu.snow.snowsmoothshading.i: Enable/Disable whether th' snow has smooth shading
physicsmod.menu.snow.snowquality.info: High will require a lot o' allocated RAM (6 GB+) otherwise Minecraft might freeze 'n crash.
physicsmod.menu.snow.grasssnowy.info: Enable/Disable whether snowy grass blocks get replaced by actual snow
physicsmod.menu.snow.warning: Weak CPUs, too high chunk render distances or high snow quality might result in delayed snow tracks by entities and/or lag.
physicsmod.menu.snow.customize.reset: Be ye sure ye wish t' reset yer snow block settins'?
physicsmod.menu.sound.title.main.info: Just some sound settins' fer th' weather 'n block physics. Not too exciting.
physicsmod.menu.sound.title: Sound Settins'
physicsmod.menu.sound.soundvolume.info: This is multiplied by th' blocks volume in th' main Minecraft sound settins'.
physicsmod.menu.sound.windvolume.info: This is multiplied by th' weather volume in th' main Minecraft sound settins'.
This is multiplied by th' ambient volume in th' main Minecraft sound settins'.

Despawn Animation Settins'

physicsmod.menu.smoke.title.main.info: Don't get stuck in a building without a chimney. It could get very smoky!
physicsmod.menu.smoke.title: Smoke Settins' (PRO VERSION REQUIRED)
physicsmod.menu.smoke.reset: Be ye sure ye wish t' reset yer smoke settins'?
physicsmod.menu.smoke.warning: Not all shaders be compatible. Temporal Anti-Aliasing (TAA, shader settin') can cause visual artifacts so I suggest disabling it.
physicsmod.menu.smoke.shadow.title: Select th' shaderpack that ye be using
physicsmod.menu.smoke.shadow.info: Set this t' th' shaderpack ye be using (not all shaderpacks be supported but ye can try different settins', it might work) fer proper shadows.
physicsmod.menu.smoke.particledespawntim: Th' remaining time once th' smoke hits open air 'n starts despawning.
physicsmod.menu.smoke.cudasmoke.info: High quality smoke simulated on yer GPU. High performance impact. Might cause game crashes.
physicsmod.menu.smoke.cudasmoke.error: Only Nvidia GPUs on Windows be supported!
physicsmod.menu.smoke.smokevolumetricphy: High quality volumetric smoke. High performance impact.
Yer GPU doesn't support Volumetric Smoke.
physicsmod.menu.weather.title.main.info: Weather physics will apply wind t' physics objects 'n turn all rain, snow 'n desert dust (NEW!) into particles also affected by wind forces!
physicsmod.menu.weather.title: Weather Settins'
physicsmod.menu.weather.particlesamountr: Spawns X amount o' particles per open air block. This has a high performance impact.
physicsmod.menu.weather.particlesamountt: Spawns X amount o' particles additionally t' th' rain amount per open air block. This has a high performance impact.
physicsmod.menu.weather.rainstrength.inf: Th' total wind strength is calculated as follows: Clear Weather Strength + Rain Weather Strength (when it rains/thunders) + Thunder Weather Strength (when it thunders)
physicsmod.menu.weather.opacity.info: Existing particles in th' world will not update t' th' new opacity settin'. Please wait fer new particles t' spawn t' see th' updated opacity. Some shaders might ignore this settin'.
physicsmod.menu.weather.reset: Be ye sure ye wish t' reset yer weather settins'?
physicsmod.menu.collapse.title.main.info: CAREFUL! This could destroy yer entire house. Whenever a block gets placed/destroyed it triggers a structure collapse.
physicsmod.menu.collapse.title: Collapse Settins'
